scope.version_meaning: Dataset commit. No governing protocol or study-approved interpretation accompanied the criterion.

binding.domain: Synthetic flat records contain completed calendar years at the local start date of the selected screening encounter, recorded as whole-valued floats. Fractional observed ages are outside this cross-engine contract.
binding.status: Patient is linked to a study-tagged in-progress Encounter. Both versions are present at the offset-qualified snapshot cutoff.
binding.missing: An absent Patient.birthDate and a null flat age represent the same missing measurement.

control_sources.identity: Within each artifact, use the integer id and its patient_id. Each flat age is directly specified. The FHIR branch constructs resources exclusively from the dated chart inputs. The single-record and resource version is 1.
control_sources.scope: Complete controls enter the SQL set comparison. The missing-age control is reported separately.
